model.title: A resolution recognizing the seriousness of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and expressing support for the designation of September 2026 as "PCOS Awareness Month".

summary.text: The resolution seeks to recognize polycystic ovary syndrome as a serious health condition and express support for designating September 2026 as "PCOS Awareness Month" to increase public understanding of this common reproductive health disorder.
